items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Crosby was the one I knew at that time. ... [INTERVIEWEE] he'd been with Bob Crosby.

ctx.x: I think he died in 49. That was before, he died before I came to New Orleans in 49. In any case, but he'd been around for many, many years and in and out of town, of course, too. So he had a reputation. Yeah,
